owner_decisions.verbatim: Xác nhận: cho phép ghi quyền commit/push thường trực vào AGENTS.md, docs/08, ORCHESTRATE, RESUME và các profile: chỉ qua timesheet-committer, thẳng main đến bản release đầu tiên, sau đó dùng nhánh phụ + PR; cấm amend, force-push, viết lại lịch sử, tạo tag; không commit secret, chữ ký hay dữ liệu cá nhân. Nếu bộ lọc vẫn chặn subagent, tôi đồng ý để bạn tự ghi đúng các dòng về quyền commit
owner_decisions.decision: Standing commit/push authorization may be written into AGENTS.md, docs/08, ORCHESTRATE, RESUME and the profiles: timesheet-committer only; main until the first release, then side branches + PR; no amend, force-push, history rewrite or tags; no secrets, signatures or personal data. Fallback: the coordinator may write exactly the commit-authority lines itself if the classifier still blocks the subagent.

owner_decisions.decision: Adopt the WP2-PLAN recommendations: E-2 no new day category for OT-funded leave; day entries carry leave minutes with a leave_kind (vacation | sick | ot); L for deficits = the day's leave minutes entered by the employee; the UI warns when the day's OT-kind leave minutes differ from the leave request's consumed minutes; never auto-spend. E-3 OT leave is consumed only by an explicit, idempotent employee 'record use' action on or after the leave date (partial allowed); an unconsumed reservation stays reserved until used or cancelled and WP3 review flags it. E-8 keep plain CSS; adopt 4px radius and 300 ms ease-out transitions through CSS custom properties; amend the AGENTS.md UI section accordingly (governance change).

auxiliary_lookups.purpose: Read-only documentation check: subagent model aliases, effort levels per model, per-dispatch overrides, profile reload behaviour, subscription usage weighting and git attribution/permission settings.

documented: Model aliases: sonnet=Sonnet 5.5, opus=Opus 5.5, haiku, fable=Fable 5.1 (explicit selection only), best (Fable where available else Opus), inherit, opusplan, default; full model IDs accepted.
Effort values: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultracode; Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable support all; agent-frontmatter effort needs Claude Code 2.1.200+ (installed 2.1.285 per WF-REVIEW).

Per-dispatch model override precedes frontmatter, then CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then main-session model; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1 forces one model. No per-dispatch effort override: vary effort through separate profiles.
Official guidance: Sonnet for routine work, Opus for complex decisions, Haiku to reduce subagent cost; higher effort raises thinking tokens.
Fable usage may bill to usage credits on some plans.
inferred_or_unknown: Main-session user-selected model outranks the settings agent frontmatter (inferred; matches observed Opus 5.5).
Profile hot reload without restart: not documented; verify empirically after profile edits.
Opus versus Sonnet subscription weighting: not published.
Git commit/push by subagents follows the client's Bash permission rules; permission settings remain owner-controlled and are not changed by this mission.
coordinator_constraints: Do not route to fable or best (possible usage-credit billing) without explicit owner approval.
Effort tiers require profiles; model may vary per dispatch only with a recorded reason.
